description: Single pre-flight call before settling. Runs oracle check, compliance screen, and stablecoin routing in parallel and returns a unified go/no-go decision. Replaces the 3-step oracle → screen → route loop. Returns: decision (PROCEED/HOLD/BLOCKED), recommended token, estimated net received, oracle score, compliance verdict, and a ready-to-use settleBody.

address.description: Counterparty wallet address for compliance screen (optional but recommended)

lei.description: Counterparty LEI for enhanced compliance check (optional)

name: flow_check

estimatedNetUsd.description: Estimated net received after all fees

settleBody.description: Ready to POST to /settle (null if BLOCKED or HOLD)
